purpose: Schema-only contract for fully synthetic public demonstrations

aggregationLegend.sum: Sum only compatible units, periods and disjoint records.
aggregationLegend.snapshot_sum: Sum disjoint entities within ONE snapshot and compatible state; never snapshots over time.
aggregationLegend.weighted_ratio: Recalculate with an appropriate denominator, never sum percentages.
aggregationLegend.non_additive: Display at grain; no total or average without a supported business formula.

datasets.grain: Purchase detail row identified by Id; item, store, supplier and date are present.
datasets.caveat: Quantity comparison only. No prices, monetary amounts, order status, receipt promises or GL account are supplied. Receipt and invoice quantities do not establish OTIF or posting status.
datasets.syntheticGuidance: Generate independent fictitious values only. No source cells, identities, dates, prices or operational amounts are to be copied. Synthetic undated-table snapshot is explicitly 2026-07-31, not a source timestamp.

datasets.grain: Customer-level scorecard; no period or transaction denominator is supplied.
datasets.caveat: Customer GM can be sales-weighted only across compatible periods/currencies. YoY percentages cannot be summed or averaged without prior-period revenue. OTIF percentages have no eligible-order denominator and must not be averaged into network OTIF. No item-level prices.
datasets.syntheticGuidance: Generate independent fictitious values only. No source cells, identities, dates, prices or operational amounts are to be copied. Synthetic undated-table snapshot is explicitly 2026-07-31, not a source timestamp.

datasets.grain: Order milestone/export row; Order No is not unique in the supplied source.
datasets.caveat: Duplicate orders and missing milestones exist. Do not count rows as distinct orders. No ordered/delivered quantities or eligible-order denominator: delivery flags do not establish OTIF. Max. Euro has an unconfirmed unit; it must not be formatted as currency. Source is transport milestones, not POS telemetry or proven root causes.
datasets.syntheticGuidance: Generate independent fictitious values only. No source cells, identities, dates, prices or operational amounts are to be copied. Synthetic undated-table snapshot is explicitly 2026-07-31, not a source timestamp.

datasets.grain: Item ledger export row; document/item/date alone is not proven unique.
datasets.caveat: Quantity unit and actual-cost currency are not confirmed. Packaging conversions are non-additive master-data attributes. No GL account, posted amount, posting status, or debit/credit mapping; this is not proof of GL posting.
datasets.syntheticGuidance: Generate independent fictitious values only. No source cells, identities, dates, prices or operational amounts are to be copied. Synthetic undated-table snapshot is explicitly 2026-07-31, not a source timestamp.

datasets.grain: Item × customer × forecast calendar year/month export cell; GTIN is not a guaranteed unique item key.
datasets.caveat: Blank/dash forecast cells mean unknown, not zero. No forecast version, actual sales, budget or store dimension is supplied. Do not invent store allocations, forecast accuracy or budget attainment. Exact item-key population mismatch must be preserved when joining stock.
datasets.syntheticGuidance: Generate independent fictitious values only. No source cells, identities, dates, prices or operational amounts are to be copied. Synthetic undated-table snapshot is explicitly 2026-07-31, not a source timestamp.

datasets.grain: Item × warehouse × customer × stock-state export row; no source snapshot date.
datasets.caveat: Stock is a categorical state, not a quantity. Available, blocked, non-allocated, sales-order and purchase-order states may overlap or refer to different concepts: never sum all states as physical on-hand. No lot receipt/expiry date or cost is supplied; stock aging is unavailable.
datasets.syntheticGuidance: Generate independent fictitious values only. No source cells, identities, dates, prices or operational amounts are to be copied. Synthetic undated-table snapshot is explicitly 2026-07-31, not a source timestamp.

datasets.grain: Article × pallet serial × nullable batch export row; a physical pallet may have several rows.
datasets.caveat: Expected packaging quantities are not additive. Count distinct pallet serials, not rows, for physical pallets. Missing batch is unknown. No paired physical LSP and SAP measurements, source snapshot date or expiry date is supplied.
datasets.syntheticGuidance: Generate independent fictitious values only. No source cells, identities, dates, prices or operational amounts are to be copied. Synthetic undated-table snapshot is explicitly 2026-07-31, not a source timestamp.

datasets.grain: Department-labelled detail rows, not one pre-aggregated row per department; hidden detail key is absent.
datasets.caveat: Repeated departments require aggregation, not lookup joins. Relative months have no source calendar anchor. Snapshot balances are additive across disjoint entities, never across dates. Source coverage values above 13 represent a different unit (13-month forecast pieces), not months; they require null/flag treatment. No expiry data or exact inactive duration.

datasets.grain: One item export row, with relative historical sales, future forecasts and snapshot balances.
datasets.caveat: All 42 supplied fields are represented with neutral report headers. Relative months have no source calendar anchor. EUR value divided by pieces is a blended value per piece, not an approved current/next selling price. Snapshot balances must not sum over time. Source coverage values above 13 are overloaded with a pieces measure and must not be treated as months. Planner email is private; demo uses example.com only. No batch expiry date.
